newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL, TVK sign 4-yr delivery deal.
newsitem.headline: MOL, TVK sign 4-yr delivery deal.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt signed a contract to deliver chemicals company TVK Rt nearly one million tonnes of chemical benzene per year for the next four years, the two companies said on Thursday.
Hungarian news agency MTI reported that the new agreement replaces a previous one concluded in 1993, when both companies were state-owned.
The new deal is effective until December 31, 2000.
The value of the contract was not revealed but MOL and TVK officials said it was based on international prices.
The contract will enable TVK to minimize reserves and guarantee the required supplies, they said. TVK's order will cover one seventh of MOL's total liquid hydrocarbon turnover.
